owner: CC builds it; cairn/devices/tester owns the reseal door and the hook

watchme.trigger: every reseal that reports at least one CHANGED seal — the event already fires, on every commit that touches a proved file.
watchme.enough: when 20 reseal-changing commits have landed and none was followed by a dirty validation file; at that point the hook's staging is measured rather than assumed.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: the tree is clean after the commit the reseal rode.
watchme.nexus: the tester's own validation store — the same records the reseal writes, so the watch costs no new table
watchme.consumer: CC, and Akien through the operator inbox if the rate says the hook is still writing behind the committer

children: none, because it is one hook and one door
sorted_berth: none, because a bug enters directly as a ticket — /intent's own SKILL.md: 'Do not route a bug through here: if editing lines of code fixes it, it is a ticket'. Node class CairnCommons/node_classes/bug.json.
intent_berth: none, because a bug enters directly as a ticket — see sorted_berth.
